name: MelBand RoFormer Kim | Vocals (Kimberley Jensen)
notes: Checkpoint SHA-256 and byte size are pinned from the upstream v0.1.5 checksum manifest.
Configuration is pinned to the upstream v0.1.5 source tag.
The model emits vocals; instrumental is computed as mixture minus vocals and is not a native model prediction.
Upstream inference does not resample input audio; this manifest therefore requires 44100 Hz input.
The upstream inference implementation duplicates mono input to stereo for inference and writes the vocal output back as mono.

name: HT-Demucs 6-stem (ONNX, StemSplit)
notes: Model assets are managed and cached by demucs-onnx through Hugging Face Hub; they are not downloaded through mseparate's SHA-pinned asset manager.
Explicit --device cuda validates a CUDA-only ONNX Runtime session and disables runtime retry fallback; auto mode may include CPU as a fallback.
The piano stem is experimental and may contain substantial bleed or artifacts; audition before relying on it.
The model emits six estimates from the full mix: drums, bass, other, vocals, guitar and piano.
mseparate converts input audio to 44100 Hz before inference and converts every output stem back to the original input sample rate; the original source file is never modified.

name: BS-RoFormer Anvuew | Vocals
notes: Checkpoint and config are pinned to Hugging Face revision 7e4e5669cad8a8810983e02fa25294229246d374; both SHA-256 digests and byte sizes are recorded.
The Hugging Face model repository declares GPL-3.0 for this checkpoint and its configuration. Preserve GPL-3.0 notices and terms when redistributing the model assets.
The model is configured for 44100 Hz stereo processing; mseparate resamples model-facing audio to 44100 Hz and restores output to the original sample rate.
The native vocals estimate is exposed; the optional instrumental output is derived as mixture-minus-vocals residual, not a native model estimate.

name: BS-RoFormer SW Fixed | 6 stems (candidate)
notes: Candidate checkpoint mirror of the six-stem BS-RoFormer SW model; output order is bass, drums, other, vocals, guitar, piano.

The public mirror reports an unknown license. This entry is intentionally disabled pending confirmation of upstream weight rights, immutable checkpoint/config revisions, SHA-256 checksums, and runtime compatibility.
The six-stem model is a general music separator, not a model specifically trained for electronic music.

name: ZFTurbo BS-RoFormer | 53 stems (candidate)
notes: Official ZFTurbo release describes a 53-output BS-RoFormer checkpoint, including a synth stem; outputs may overlap and are not guaranteed to sum to the mix.
The upstream release warns that inference is memory-intensive and recommends at least 16 GB VRAM; the 53-stem model may not fit an 8 GB GPU.
This is a broad instrument model with a synth output, not an electronic-genre-specific specialist.
Kept disabled until the exact release assets, weight license, config/checkpoint hashes, output mapping, and local inference compatibility are verified.

name: MVSep Synth | Synth and other (research candidate)
notes: MVSep documents a Synth extraction algorithm whose synth family includes synth pads, synth bass, synth vocals, synth strings, synth percussion, synth FX, synth keys, synth brass, synth guitar and synth flute.

No public downloadable checkpoint, configuration, local inference backend, or redistribution license was verified during this research. This registry entry is informational and intentionally ineligible for execution.
The synth-family list describes content grouped into the synth output; it is not evidence that the model emits a separate stem for every listed subtype.
